Below is a one-line patch to stop using the entire URL as the filesystem name (which pulls in slashes and “:” characters) and instead use only the URL’s basename. This preserves the existing behavior (write the contents into mediabag, update `el.src`, etc.) but guarantees a valid filename so XeLaTeX can include it.

```javascript
### src/resources/filters/quarto-finalize/mediabag.lua
<<<<<<< SEARCH
          local mediabagDir = param("mediabag-dir", nil)
          local mediaFile = pandoc.path.join{mediabagDir, el.src}

          local file = _quarto.file.write(mediaFile, contents)
=======
          local mediabagDir = param("mediabag-dir", nil)
          -- Use only the URL’s basename as the filename so that it won’t contain '/' or ':' 
          local _, fileName = pandoc.path.split(el.src)
          local mediaFile = pandoc.path.join{mediabagDir, fileName}

          local file = _quarto.file.write(mediaFile, contents)
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

Explanation of the change:

1. We still retrieve the mediabag directory via `param("mediabag-dir")`.
2. Instead of joining the full `el.src` (which, when it is a URL, contains invalid characters for a filename), we split off just the last segment of the path with `pandoc.path.split(el.src)` and use that as `fileName`.
3. We then write out the file under `mediabagDir/fileName` and update `el.src` exactly as before—now pointing to a valid local path.
